content.title: Cavaliers vs. Lakers: Prediction, How to Watch for Free (3/31/26)
content.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers (47–28) face the Los Angeles Lakers (49–26) tonight at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles. The Lakers have won three straight and 12 out of their last 13 games. The most recent wins have come against teams that have long been out of playoff contention. Last night, they beat the Washington Wizards, 120–101, with Luka Doncic serving a one-game suspension. LeBron James stepped up, posting a triple-double with 21 points, 10 rebounds, and 12 assists. Austin Reaves, Jaxson Hayes, and Luke Kennard added 19 points each. Doncic returns to the lineup tonight to close out a month of March in which he’s averaging 37.2 PPG. Cleveland, meanwhile, enters the matchup after a 122–113 win over the Utah Jazz on Monday, powered by 34-point performances from Donovan Mitchell and Evan Mobley as the Cavaliers continued their strong offensive run heading into a key late-season stretch. The Lakers enter tonight in third place in the Western Conference, looking to consolidate that position with the Denver Nuggets 1.5 games behind. The Cavs, meanwhile, are in fourth place in the Eastern Conference, with just one game separating them from the third-place New York Knicks, with a real opportunity to secure a higher seed. With Doncic back, the Lakers have the edge here in which should be a tight contest between two teams playing some of their best basketball of the season. Final Score Prediction: Los Angeles Lakers 118, Cleveland Cavaliers 114 Injury Report Cleveland Cavaliers Sam Merrill — Out (Hamstring) Jaylon Tyson — Out (Toe) Dean Wade — Out (Ankle) Los Angeles Lakers Marcus Smart — Out (Ankle) LeBron James — GTD (Foot) How to Watch Cavaliers vs. Lakers Tip-off for tonight’s Cavaliers-Lakers game is set for 10:30 PM Eastern / 7:30 PM Pacific at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles. The game airs live locally on FanDuel Sports Network Ohio and Spectrum SportsNet Plus. Out-of-market viewers can stream the matchup on NBA League Pass for free on Amazon Prime Video with a 7-day free trial here.
